description:
Prepare the dive logbook for an annual safety review submission to the diving operations safety board. The reviewing agency requires the following conditions to be met before submission:

1. Every dive with a maximum depth greater than 18 meters must carry the tag 'deep'.
2. Every dive in the December 2010 Hoodsport trip (Dives #2 through #5) must have a buddy name recorded. Any dive currently missing a buddy should be assigned buddy 'David Price' (the divemaster who was present on all dives that trip).
3. The display units must be set to Imperial (feet, psi, Fahrenheit, lbs) as required by the US-based reviewing board.
4. A CSV export of the complete dive log must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/safety_audit_export.csv.

Complete all four requirements and save all changes to the logbook.

subtasks.deep_tagging: Tag all dives deeper than 18m with 'deep'
subtasks.buddy_fill: Fill missing buddy fields in Dec 2010 trip with 'David Price'
